hooks.command: python -c "import os, datetime, pathlib; p = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_FILE_PATH', '?'); pathlib.Path('.claude/session.log').parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); open('.claude/session.log', 'a', encoding='utf-8').write(f\"[{datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M')}] {os.path.basename(p)}\n\")"
